basic_details.short_information: District Medical & Health Officer, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District (DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri) is recruiting candidates for 1 Medical Officer post on a contract basis in Basti Dhawakhana under NHM. Eligible BC-A local candidates who possess an MBBS registered with the TG Medical Council and are aged 18 to 46 years as on 1 July 2026 can apply for the post. The remuneration for the post is Rs. 52,000. Candidates must download the offline application form from the official website and submit the filled form in person or through registered post, along with a Demand Draft of Rs. 300 in favour of Distri

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 6 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. When does the application process start?
faq.answer: Applications commence on 3 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for this Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are invited only from BC-A candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Download the Application Form and Guidelines from https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in, fill in the form, enclose copies of the required certificates and submit it at the DMHO office in Raigir.

faq.question: Q5. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application is submitted at G-17, IDOC, Raigir, O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Medical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post of Medical Officer is filled on contract basis in Basti Dhawakhana under the National Health Mission (NHM).

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Medical Officer work?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer will work in Basti Dhawakhana under NHM in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana.

faq.question: Q8. What is the notification number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is under Notification No.04/2026, dated 2 November 2026.
